blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب ما يقول اذا اصبح رقم:٥٠٧٩
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Muslim ibn Harith (RA) narrates that the Prophet ﷺ told him secretly, “After Maghrib Salah, recite seven times (اَللّهُمَّ أَجِرْنِي مِنَ النَّارِ) O Allah! Protect me from the Fire! If you die that very night, you will be protected from the Fire! Likewise, recite this Du'a seven times after Fajr as well. If you die during that day, you will be protected from the Fire.”

blocks.text:
Explanation: The Prophet ﷺ said it secretly so that the importance of the message being told would be in the heart of the listener.
(Badhl-ul-Majhud)

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ أُمِّ فَرْوَةَ ﵂ قَالَتْ: سُئِلَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ أَيُّ اْلاَعْمَالِ أَفْضَلُ؟ قَالَ: اَلصَّلَاةُ فِي أَوَّلِ وَقْتِهَا.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب المحافظة علي الصلوات رقم:٤٢٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Umm Farwah (RA) narrates, “Which of the deeds is best?” the Prophet ﷺ was asked. He replied, “Performing Salah at the beginning of its time.”

blocks.arabic_text: عَنْ عَلِيٍّ ﵁ قَالَ: قَالَ رَسُولُ اللهِ ﷺ: يَا أَهْلَ الْقُرْآنِ! أَوْتِرُوا فَإِنَّ اللهَ وِتْرٌ يُحِبُّ الْوِتْرَ.
blocks.source_reference_arabic: رواه ابوداؤد باب استحباب الوتر رقم:١٤١٦
blocks.tamil_translation: Hazrat Ali (RA) narrates that the Messenger of Allah ﷺ said, “O people of the Qur'an! (O Muslims!) Keep praying the “Witr' Salah. For Allah is 'Witr' (One). He loves those who pray Witr.”
